semiconductor_relevance: High — Duksan Tecopia is involved in the production of ALD/CVD precursors and high-purity materials crucial for semiconductor fabrication.
summary: Duksan Tecopia Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of ALD/CVD precursors and high-purity materials for OLED displays, playing a significant role in the semiconductor and optical communication industries. The company focuses on fine chemical synthesis within the electronic materials sector, aiming to be a global leader in semiconductor and display materials.
capabilities: Production of ALD/CVD precursors for thin-film deposition
Development of high-purity materials for OLED displays
Manufacture of organic fluorescent and phosphorescent substances
Supply of ultra-high-purity sources for optical fiber applications
